answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The canyon holds work receipts rather than names, so the karst of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, capped per identity per epoch, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the opal of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
